meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 做代码审查时,Claude 会输出压缩格式的评论:每条一行,写清位置(行号或文件)、问题和具体修复方案,不写「我注意到」「看起来」这类开场白。产出的评论可直接粘贴进 PR。
howto.when: 当你说 “review this PR”、“review the diff” 等,或使用 /caveman-review 时接管;遇到安全类发现等情形会临时改回详细段落。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 帮我审一下这个 PR
say.note: 每条一行给出位置、问题、修复
多文件时带文件名和行号

say.text: stop caveman-review,恢复详细审查风格
say.note: 改回啰嗦的正常评论模式

howto.what_en: When reviewing code, Claude writes compressed comments: one line per finding with location, problem, and concrete fix, no preamble. The output is ready to paste into a PR.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff". Falls back to full paragraphs for security findings and similar cases.

say_en.text: Use caveman-review to review this PR
say_en.note: One line per finding: location, problem, fix
Multi-file diffs get file and line numbers
